question: Can a tiny gain parameter selected solely from preregistered development time-series improve the causal median-error feedback learned from W-R24 across heldout regime-shift amplitudes, without post-result threshold tuning?
hypothesis: Fixed feedback0.25 delivered weak late accuracy gain with early harm in W-R24. A development-only gain chosen among four frozen candidates may improve out-of-family late-regime generalization and reduce early degradation.
source: Raw first-channel 16-tick quadratic base+three-level dev jitter/five-level heldout jitter exactly per W-R22. Development-training seeds104..105 are stationary to learn one frozen curvature scalar. Development-validation seeds106..107 contain a known +2*max(0,t-8)^2 regime shift; their true next ticks may be used ONLY for supervised development gain selection. Heldout seeds108..111 have new +3*max(0,t-8)^2 regime shift with five-level varying jitter; no heldout labels used for learning.
gain_selection: Evaluate postchange MAE of causal median of last up to three *past frozen-predictor residuals* on exactly the 2 gain-validation seeds, select minimum MAE; break numerical ties by smaller gain. Freeze chosen gain before observing heldout outputs. All arms retain identical five-observation context and one development curvature scalar+one gain scalar.
arms: fixed gain0.25 median of last3 causal residuals
single selected development-only gain median of last3 causal residuals
primary: Report actual selected gain, dev validation MAE for all four candidates, sealed-heldout by-seed pre/post/full circular MAE. DEV_GAIN_TRANSFER only if selected-gain postchange MAE <=0.9*frozen postchange MAE and prechange <=1.1*frozen prechange MAE and selected-gain postchange improves on fixed gain0.25. PARTIAL if selected-gain improves postchange frozen but fails any strict criterion. NEGATIVE otherwise. Preserve negative including gain0.
controls: No heldout leakage, no post-result parameter sweep, immutable identities, all simulations deterministic twice, zero external model calls, original first-use archive, one full regression and accepted-ref isolation.
claim_limit: Synthetic autoregressive gain selection, not general-purpose reasoning.
